title: Understanding Private Evolution as Learning-Augmented Clustering
gist: Apple researchers (NeurIPS paper, Nov 2026) recast Private Evolution (PE), a differentially private synthetic-data algorithm, as generative-model-augmented Wasserstein learning, explaining why it beats worst-case bounds: a good generator makes sample complexity depend on intrinsic rather than ambient dimension. They also show standard PE can fail on simple well-clustered data and propose a geometry-aware PE with provable convergence and improved recall.
